note: Approximate averages for periods that predate daily collection. Monthly figures are the midpoint of GoodReturns' published monthly high and low for Hyderabad silver, converted from ₹/kg to ₹/gram. Yearly 2021-2025 are Motilal Oswal's indicative India-wide annual averages, likewise converted. 2026 is deliberately NOT their ₹3,30,000/kg 'till date' figure, which contradicts every Hyderabad reading we hold (measured ₹2.55L, no month above ₹2.93L); it is the mean of the seven monthly midpoints below. 2026 has far too little daily coverage to override this seed, so it renders all year.
